# MCP tool catalogue

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:mcp-tools` from the tool registries. Do not edit by hand: lib/agent/tool-catalogue.test.ts fails when this file is out of date. -->

Every tool the fund's MCP server (`/api/mcp`) can list: 357 in all. How to connect, approvals, funds and limits are in [MCP](./MCP.md).

A connection lists only the tools its member may use: the areas they can read, the features the fund has on, and changes only when the connection may change things. The REST agent API (`/api/agent`) runs the same tools apart from the connection, dashboard and approval groups.

- **Change**: the tool writes. A read-only connection is refused.
- **From a chat**: what a change does when Claude or ChatGPT calls it. With an API key, a change runs at once unless it says it always waits.
- **Admin only**: a member who is not an admin can still propose it from a chat; an admin approves it.

## Connection

Always listed. `list_funds` and `use_fund` appear only on a connection that can work in more than one fund.

| Tool | Change | From a chat | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `call_tool` | Yes | As the tool it runs | Run any tool on this server by name, with the same checks, approvals and results as calling it directly. |
| `list_funds` |  |  | The funds this connection can work in, and which one is active now. |
| `search_tools` |  |  | Find tools on this server, including ones added since this conversation started (your tool list may be cached). |
| `use_fund` |  |  | Switch the active fund for this conversation. |

## Approvals

Staged changes and runs. A member sees and decides only the changes they staged; an admin sees all of them.

| Tool | Change | From a chat | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `approve_action` | Yes | Runs at once | Apply a staged change: one this chat staged, or (for an admin) someone else's, such as a member's proposal waiting for an admin. |
| `list_pending_actions` |  |  | Changes waiting for approval: ones staged from this chat or another, and ones the in-app Analyst drafted. |
| `list_runs` |  |  | Runs (stage_run) that were approved and applied, or stopped partway: each with its title, status, what every step did, the checks on the books and whether it has been undone. |
| `reject_action` | Yes | Runs at once | Discard a staged change the user does not want. |
| `stage_run` | Yes | Runs at once | Stage several changes as ONE run for a person to approve once, instead of one approval per change. |
| `undo_run` | Yes | Runs at once | Take back what an applied run created, where that is safe, as Undo on the Approvals page does: the journal entries it posted are voided and the investment transactions it recorded deleted, last ste... |
